preconditions.description: Attacker needs sufficient WBTC and DAI tokens to manipulate the Uniswap WBTC/DAI pool
Attacker needs DAI tokens to trade against WBTC in the Uniswap pool

exploit_hint: Manipulate the Uniswap WBTC/DAI pool price by executing large trades to skew the price, then exploit contracts that rely on getPriceByWBTCDAI() for pricing. First, swap large amounts of DAI for WBTC to artificially inflate WBTC price, then use the manipulated price to mint/exchange tokens at favorable rates. After exploitation, reverse trades to restore pool balance and profit from the arbitrage.
